blockers.message: the review record has no `## code.review` section, while roles were active at it

findings.evidence: - A plugin system for export formats, so that PDF, XLSX, XML and JSON exports can be added later by dropping a module in `src/export/plugins/`.
findings.recommendation: The Why is accountants copying invoices one by one into a spreadsheet; one CSV route answers it. Drop the plugin system from What Changes, the registry decision from design.md ("Exports go through a plugin registry", whose only rejected alternative — "a single CSV function (not extensible)" — is the one the Why calls for), task 1.2 (`npm test -- registry`, which no spec scenario backs, so its done state cannot be observed) and `src/export/plugins/` from Impact. Add other formats in their own change when someone asks for them.
findings.title: A plugin system for four future formats nobody asked for

findings.evidence: The settings page SHALL let a user choose their preferred export format among the installed plugins.
findings.location: specs/invoice-export/spec.md#Requirement: Users choose their export format
findings.recommendation: Nothing in the Why asks for a format preference, and with CSV the only format the choice has no effect: the route is `GET /invoices.csv`, so the scenario "WHEN a user picks CSV THEN exports use CSV" cannot fail and checks nothing. The design's "A settings page stores each user's preferred format" also needs a stored per-user value the plan never places (no table or column in Impact, `migration` unticked) and touches `web/src/settings/` with `user-interface` unticked. Drop the requirement, the What Changes bullet, the design sentence, task 2.1 and `web/src/settings/` from Impact.
findings.title: A per-user export-format settings page nobody asked for

findings.recommendation: `GET /invoices.csv` returns every invoice of a month with its customer and total, and the spec has no scenario for who may call it (no unauthorized case: an unauthenticated request would get the whole month). Tick `security` and `personal-data` so their experts review the route, or write the reason on each line if access is already guarded elsewhere; and add the unauthorized scenario to "Invoices are exported as CSV".
findings.title: The export route exposes customer data with every domain unticked
